prior_disposition: An earlier exact-head review accepted the current Arabic target; the later W2100–W2199 cross-review separately queued this cell for caller-composition review. The current caller file is unchanged from those pinned reviews and is reattested here at the new live PR head.
rationale: In this caller the adjective follows the definite Arabic noun الحلقات. `متاحة` is indefinite and leaves the composed phrase grammatically incomplete; `المتاحة` agrees as the feminine singular adjective for a non-human plural and carries the definite article required by the noun phrase. This also matches the definite form of the sibling requestable label.
